mappings.basis: Unit 1 states that ferries may dock at the east pier (direct). Unit 2 denies that same permission for the same actor and place without naming any population, case or circumstance, so it is opposite; both cite the target quote.

mapping_doubts.note: Unit 2 ('Ferries may not dock at the east pier') could be read as a garbled rendering of the 'unless the tide is low' exception, but its assertion names no case, so under question 3 it is opposite rather than inverse; its evidence also does not touch the exception clause.
